payload.headline: Every paths land is refused land-backlog-index-failed: who repairs the bad backlog and discussion files?

parts.cause: Files on main fail the backlog index check: six rows from 3963004f4 and nearby lack a Notes section (p-cgf7ssy6ua, p-v5on3imj3d, p-jsmlktofj4, p-5qpb7pas5b, p-mh6ogs34dn, p-yoec2tz5nf); ds-e6j4mqobei DISCUSSION.md has no frontmatter; ds-ubqlutna6r cites source ds-wqsrwmiier (must start with p-); p-dw3h5wscns is done while plan 261124-0004 citing it is running. None are the supervisor's, and no secretary is live.

options.does: Next secretary wake adds empty Notes sections, the ds-e6j4mqobei frontmatter, fixes the ds-ubqlutna6r source and the p-dw3h5wscns citation, and lands them in one paths land.
options.gain: Rows stay with the head that owns the backlog; one commit unblocks every land.
options.harm: Waits for a secretary wake; all portfolio lands stay blocked until then.
options.label: Secretary repairs them

options.does: This supervisor makes the same mechanical edits through fgos land --paths.
options.harm: Supervisor edits rows and discussions it does not own, outside its charter.
options.label: Supervisor repairs them

options.does: You fix the files by hand.
options.gain: No head acts outside its charter.
options.label: Owner repairs them

parts.recommendation: Secretary repairs them: the fix is mechanical and the rows are hers; the supervisor retries both lands on its next wake.

scope.allows: The named head makes only the mechanical fixes listed in the cause and lands them.
scope.forbids: Changing the content or status of any row beyond those fixes, or weakening the backlog index check.

parts.what: fgos land --paths refuses every portfolio commit with land-backlog-index-failed. The leak-check plan's code is on main (ee1d9ca00) but its done edit cannot land, and the DOCOS plan cannot be admitted because its status: running edit lands the same way.

payload.headline: Heads-operate phase 2: widen the footprint by three session-attempt files, and let its unit run cargo?

parts.cause: Two causes. (1) Retiring the envelope's session.verbs needs three files outside the plan footprint: src/runner/dispatch/session-attempt.mjs (owned by draft plan 261122-2108), apps/fgos/src/wiring/unit_run_host/session_attempt.rs and its tests. (2) The unit's sandbox refused every cargo and node script as needing approval, so nothing was compiled or verified.

options.cost: One planner edit plus one rerun of the unit.
options.does: Planner adds the three files to the plan and phase 2 footprint (and records the overlap with 261122-2108); cargo and node run in the phase unit sandbox; the lead reruns phase 2 in the same worktree.
options.gain: Phase 2 finishes as designed, session.verbs fully retired.
options.harm: Touches one file 2108 will later delete or move; 2108 rebases on it.
options.label: Widen footprint, allow cargo

options.cost: One phase-file edit plus one rerun.
options.does: Planner amends phase 2 so the envelope still carries session.verbs, fed from the new table; retiring it moves to 261122-2108.
options.gain: No footprint change, no overlap with 2108.
options.harm: Two shapes of the grant live side by side until 2108 lands (L10 debt).
options.label: Keep session.verbs for now

parts.recommendation: Widen the footprint and allow cargo in the unit: the plan's outcome says GRANTS stops being an authority, which a kept session.verbs contradicts.

scope.allows: One planner edit of plan.md and phase-02 footprint, and a rerun of phase 2.
scope.forbids: Any other change of scope or decision in this plan.

parts.what: The phase 2 unit wrote the permission table, permissions.rs, forwarder.rs and the head_request.rs change in worktree 261124-0004-heads-operate-without-owner-p02 (uncommitted), then stopped blocked. The tree is half done and must not land as is.
